description:

Patient:innendaten verwalten? Für dich fängt die Arbeit da erst an. Du liebst Medizin und willst mit Technik und KI neue Antworten finden, statt den Status quo nur zu bedienen? Als Medical Data Analyst bei DocCheck baust du ein neues Geschäftsfeld in unserer eigenen Marktforschung mit auf. Im Herzen der DocCheck Community hast du direkten Zugang zur Zielgruppe. Du entwickelst aus anonymisierten Patient:innendaten Analysen und Handlungsempfehlungen für die Pharmaindustrie und prägst ein Data-Lake-Projekt von der ersten Idee an. Du hast keine Lust mehr, dich zwischen Medizin und Technik zu entscheiden? Worauf wartest du! DocCheck versetzt den kompletten Gesundheitsmarkt in absolute Effizienz-Ekstase. Egal ob News, Foren, Fachartikel, Medizinshop oder Kreativ-Agentur – DocCheck rührt den Medicals die ultimative Service-Mischung an.


Deine Substanz

Du hast einen Abschluss in Pharmazie, Medizin, Biomedizin, Public Health oder einem vergleichbaren Fach und kennst die medizinische Versorgungsrealität. Du bringst zwei bis vier Jahre Erfahrung mit Gesundheits- oder Real-World-Daten oder aus der Pharma-Marktforschung mit. ICD-10, ATC-Codes, Wirkstoff vs. Präparat und Therapielinien sind für dich Alltag. Du erkennst unplausible Werte, stellst die richtigen Fragen an Daten und weißt, welche Erkenntnisse für die Pharmaindustrie wirklich zählen. SQL oder Python sind ein Plus. Du arbeitest dich gerne mit KI-Tools in Datenbankabfragen ein. Ein sorgfältiger Umgang mit sensiblen Daten, Datenschutz und Arzneimittelsicherheit ist für dich selbstverständlich.

Dein Trip

Du bist die medizinische Stimme in unserem neuen Real-World-Data-Team. Gemeinsam mit unseren Data Scientists gehst du anonymisierten Versorgungsdaten auf den Grund. Du prüfst sie auf medizinische Plausibilität und legst fest, welche Messwerte, Diagnosen und Therapieinformationen wie strukturiert werden müssen. Medizinische und pharmazeutische Fragestellungen übersetzt du in konkrete Analyseanforderungen und entwickelst Hypothesen, etwa zu Therapieverläufen und Therapiewechseln. Die Ergebnisse interpretierst du und leitest daraus Insights und Handlungsempfehlungen ab. Erste Abfragen und Analysen baust du mit KI-Tools selbst.

title: Business Analyst Processes and Data
description:
For a renowned Swiss bank in Zurich, we are looking for an experienced business analyst. You analyse processes, data flows and systems in customer and contract management or in real estate management, and derive target pictures and decision bases from them.

Your tasks

  1. Analyse and document processes, data flows, systems and responsibilities end to end

  2. Create the as-is analysis, derive the target picture and to-be processes, define data ownership

  3. Assess optimisation potential in data storage and the system landscape

  4. Create business cases, effort estimates and risk analyses

  5. Moderate workshops and present results at management level

Your profile

  1. German at C2 level, the project language is German. Understanding of Swiss German is expected

  2. Several years as a business analyst or data analyst in banking or comparable industries

  3. Process and data analysis with BPMN, UML and visualisation tools

  4. Understanding of IT architecture, system landscapes, interfaces and data flows

  5. Confident use of Excel, PowerPoint, Jira and Confluence

Nice to have

  1. Customer and contract management, Siebel CRM

  2. Practical experience with AI tools in business analysis

  3. Power BI or Tableau, basic knowledge of CAFM and ERP

title: Revenue Operations Analyst
description:
About Augment

Logistics is broken. Let's fix it.

We are a team of engineers, product designers, and customer champions building Augie, Augment's AI teammate for supply chain. Augie reasons and acts like a seasoned operator, automating the busywork of quoting, dispatch, tracking, billing, and more for freight brokers, 3PLs, for-hire carriers, private fleets, and distributors.

Our team has scaled billion-dollar companies, built delightful products, and powered billions in commerce. If you thrive in fast-paced, high-impact environments and want to define how AI reshapes supply chain, apply today.

Overview

We're looking for a Revenue Operations Analyst to join our growing RevOps team. You'll own our deal desk, support territory planning, and run the reporting our sales leaders rely on every week as we grow from 12 AEs to more than 20. You'll also keep our data clean and handle the day-to-day work behind forecasting, quota administration, and commission calculations. This role reports to the Director of Revenue Operations.

Our GTM Motion

Our motion is outbound-led. SDRs prospect and qualify freight brokers, 3PLs, for-hire carriers, private fleets, and distributors before AEs run discovery and close. We sell across Mid-Market, Enterprise, and Strategic segments, with six-figure ARR deals and buying committees that span operations, IT, and finance. Your deal desk and reporting work needs to hold up to that complexity.

What You'll Do

  • Own the deal desk: review pricing, discounts, and non-standard terms, route approvals, and make sure every closed deal is booked correctly

  • Partner with Sales, Finance, and Legal so quotes and contracts move fast without surprises

  • Support territory planning: model coverage and capacity, manage account assignments, and keep regions and segments up to date as we roll them out, starting with Distribution

  • Own sales reporting: run the weekly forecast and pipeline reports leadership uses to call the quarter, and build dashboards for pipeline, conversion, bookings, and AE and SDR performance

  • Report contracted ARR and live, billing ARR side by side, and work with Finance so the numbers tie out

  • Keep HubSpot clean and reliable: own data quality, required fields, account ownership, and deal hygiene

  • Calculate commissions and support quota tracking, working with the Director and Finance

  • Help onboard new hires to our sales tools and processes, and document how things work

What We're Looking For

  • 2 to 4 years in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or Deal Desk at a B2B SaaS company

  • Hands-on experience running or supporting a deal desk, including pricing approvals and contract review

  • Experience supporting territory planning or account assignment

  • Hands-on CRM admin experience. We're on HubSpot, and experience there is a strong plus

  • Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills, and comfort with SQL or a BI tool

  • A detail person who cares when the numbers don't match and digs in until they do

  • Clear communication with sales leaders and reps, including pushing back when the data says otherwise

Bonus Points For

  • Experience in logistics, freight, trucking, distribution, or supply chain tech

  • Experience administering commission plans or quota models

  • Familiarity with Gong, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Seamless.ai, Clay, or BI platforms

Why Join Us?

  • Competitive Salary + Stock Options

  • Comprehensive Health, Vision, and Dental Benefits

  • Flexible PTO

  • Monthly stipend
